info.title: Princess-Session Orchestra
info.synopsis: Gli abitanti di Alipecia sono un popolo che ama il divertimento, ma un giorno improvvisamente spuntano dei misteriosi mostri chiamati Jamaok che minacciano la pace del regno. Un trio di "principesse" che non ha dimenticano mai la canzone all'interno dei propri cuori anche di fronte a qualsiasi pericolo, si fanno avanti per salvare Alipecia grazie al potere della musica.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Sorano Minamo visits a live event held in the mysterious land of Alicepia together with her best friend, Hinomoto Natsu. However, the venue is suddenly attacked by a mysterious monster. At that moment, Minamo witnesses the appearance of a “Princess,” a figure who sings and dances to vanquish the creature.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Sorano Minamo transforms into Princess Ripple but continues to struggle against monsters due to her inexperience. Just then, Princess Zeal, whom she saw recently at a concert venue, comes to her rescue and saves the day. The true identity of Princess Zeal is Shirube Kagari, who happens to be Hinomoto Natsu's idol and someone she deeply admires. Minamo learns more about the Princesses and the monsters known as Jammerwock from Kagari.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: In absolutely unstoppable form — to the point that even Princess Ripple and Princess Zeal are left speechless — Princess Meteor effortlessly takes down the Jammerwock. Still buzzing with excitement, she proposes a get-together that serves as a wrap party, victory celebration, and team mixer all rolled into one. Karaoke, tea, shopping—Minamo and the rest take full advantage of the day off to dive into the festivities of the wrap party… and everything else you’d expect on a fun-filled break day.
